receivedTs.description: The millisecond the proposal arrived, on the referee's clock, later backed by the hourly anchor.

payloadSha256.description: SHA-256 of the ciphertext, or of the canonical proposal if sent in clear.

rid.description: r_ + first 24 hex of SHA-256 over the canonical receipt without rid, keyId, sig.

keyId.description: First 16 hex of SHA-256 over the raw Ed25519 public key.

sig.description: Base64 Ed25519 signature over the canonical receipt without sig.
